newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's King Hussein to meet Clinton on April 1.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein to meet Clinton on April 1.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan will meet U.S. President Bill Clinton in Washington next Monday for talks expected to focus on rising Arab-Israeli tension, Western policy towards Iraq and U.S. aid to Jordan, officials said.
They said the king, who left hospital on Sunday after a medical checkup, would meet U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan in New York before heading for Washington for his talks with Clinton.
He is also due to meet U.S. Commerce Secretary William Daley, Secretary of State Madeleine Albright and Defence Secretary William Cohen, they said.
The king last week picked as prime minister a veteran ex-premier who signed Jordan's 1994 peace treaty with Israel and enjoyed good relations with Jordan's eastern neighbour, Iraq.

His talks with U.S. officials are expected to dwell on the Middle East peace process and Jordanian anxiety that Washington has no clear policy towards Baghdad after nearly seven years of sanctions imposed for its 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
Doctors who checked King Hussein, 61, for a recurrence of cancer said on Sunday he was free of the disease but advised him to undergo minor surgery on a swollen prostate gland.
The officials said the king might have the operation in the next few days.
King Hussein has returned annually to the Mayo Clinic in Minnesota since a successful surgery for cancer in 1992.
